concept: A wandering peacekeeper who reads every soul in a crowd and tunes a devastating discharge down to exactly the force needed to stop a fight without ending a life.

interaction.description: Soul perception maps every living soul in range; the stored discharge is released as narrow threads tuned to a chosen set of targets, sized to disable weapons and break corrupting resonance rather than lives, and the vow caps the output below lethal.

emergent_ability.name: Mercy Frequency
emergent_ability.description: A tuned release: the user perceives each soul in range and sends the discharge as threads matched to chosen targets, disabling weapons and breaking corrupting resonance while sparing the living.
limitations: Cannot target what cannot be perceived: out of perception range, or against a soul too shielded or disguised to read, the release does not fire.
Needs unbroken concentration: any break in perception collapses the tuning and the release is lost, never fired untuned.
Only a handful of targets can be tuned at once; a crowd of aggressors exceeds what one release can hold.
Each full release is a heavy strain: perception range shrinks for a while afterwards.
The vow bounds the output: the ability has no lethal setting, so it cannot end a fight that only a lethal blow would end.
emergent_ability.activation: Sustained perception of every target in range.

trait_outcomes.result_text: Carried intact: it is the targeting sense behind the tuned release.
The wavelength-matching principle is carried, but applied to each target instead of to a partner.
Dependence on a compatible partner becomes dependence on a perceivable target: with nothing perceived to tune to, the release cannot fire.
The partner's role as a channel that shapes and focuses energy becomes an instrument, a short chime of stacked rings. The partner as a person is not carried.
Cutting down corrupted souls becomes breaking corrupting resonance without ending the host.
Methodical preparation carries over: tuning a release is learned, deliberate work.
Carried as the stored source of the discharge.
Carried: the raw output stays enormous, which is why it is tuned or not used at all.
Carried as a hard bound: the ability has no lethal setting.
Precision in disabling shots becomes precision in choosing which targets the threads reach.

trait_outcomes.reason: Species physiology is not a mechanic this ability uses; carrying it would stack durability onto a perception-and-restraint design.
A reputation is a narrative role, not a transferable mechanic.

exclusions.item: the literal weapon partner as a carried companion
exclusions.reason: A separate person; only the partner's channel-shaping role is carried, as an instrument.

exclusions.item: the academy setting and its hierarchy
exclusions.reason: Setting and institution, not a mechanic.
Excluded by the vow: there is no setting that releases the discharge untuned.
A reputation is a narrative role, not a transferable mechanic.
A biological trait the authored rule does not use.

subject.descriptor: a calm traveler casting fine threads of pale gold light

hair.descriptor: dark, close-cropped hair with a thin braided cord at the nape

palette.descriptor: slate blue, undyed linen and oxidized brass

design_delta.to: a palm-length bundle of stacked brass rings
